group.ja: 最適化・確率・逆問題

summary.ja: Bratu方程式の合成観測からλを推定し、離散随伴勾配と区間制約付き勾配法を検証する。
summary.en: Estimate Bratu lambda from synthetic observations and verify discrete-adjoint gradients with bounded projected-gradient optimization.

references.label: A new approach to variable metric algorithms (1970)
references.scope: Method-specific source; see the detailed reading for source role and actual review depth.

references.label: Minimization of functions having Lipschitz continuous first partial derivatives (1966)
references.scope: Original sufficient-decrease and backtracking construction; the detailed chapter distinguishes the local projected implementation from the original theorem.

assumptions: Smooth, locally nonsingular lower-branch Bratu states on a fixed mesh; fixed Dirichlet data.
Five fixed interior sensors, known positive observation weights and one bounded scalar parameter lambda.
Projected-gradient Armijo iteration uses adjoint gradients; convergence is checked independently of the known generating parameter.
units: Dimensionless state and lambda; weighted least squares uses explicit sensor weights, not spatial integration weights.
boundary_conditions: u(0)=u(1)=0, independent of lambda; observation locations fixed on [0,1].

next_deliverable.ja: 多パラメータ推定・正則化選択・実測データと準Newton法の独立検証。
next_deliverable.en: Independent validation of multiple parameters, regularization selection, real data and quasi-Newton methods.

limitations.ja: 教育用の1パラメータ逆問題。検証範囲は滑らかな下側分枝、固定した合成観測、区間制約付き射影勾配法とArmijo線探索。同じ離散モデルでの回復、連続解析解からの観測による格子バイアス、固定ノイズによる推定値のずれを分ける。準Newton法、実測データ、分枝同定、統計的信頼区間は検証しない。
limitations.en: An educational one-parameter inverse problem on the smooth lower branch with fixed synthetic observations, bounded projected gradients and Armijo search. Same-discrete-model recovery, grid bias against continuous analytic observations and shifts under fixed noise are distinguished. Quasi-Newton methods, real data, branch identification and statistical confidence intervals are outside the verified scope.

metadata_review.level: bounded scalar inverse example; adjoint versus tangent and re-solved finite differences; synthetic-data and grid-bias checks

assumptions_ja: 固定格子・固定Dirichlet境界の滑らかなBratu下側分枝を用い、状態ヤコビ行列が局所的に可逆である。
固定した内部5点の観測、既知の正の観測重み、区間制約を持つ1個のスカラーパラメータλを用いる。
射影勾配法とArmijo線探索の探索方向に随伴勾配を用い、収束判定と生成パラメータの既知値との比較を分ける。
units_ja: 状態とλは無次元。重み付き最小二乗の観測重みを明記し、空間積分の求積重みと区別する。
boundary_conditions_ja: u(0)=u(1)=0をλに依存せず固定し、観測位置も区間[0,1]内で固定する。
code_mapping_scope: Separate immutable Bratu inverse supplement. One scalar parameter, projected adjoint-gradient Armijo search, same-mesh recovery, continuous-observation refinement and deterministic-noise checks; the original broad code edition is unchanged.
